items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Bache does that on Shake It and Break It.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear that, Bill? I've heard some breaks, though. I don't know whether it's intentional. What do you say that one?
No, Bache does it. Bache does that on Shake It and Break It. That record, I don't know if you remember it. But the band will stop.
Oh, you mean that's a break.
